props.heading: Style that speaks. Confidence that stays.
props.sub:
Bloom & Blade is a unisex salon on Beltarodi Road — haircut and beard on one side of the chair, keratin, facial and bridal makeup on the other.

Sixteen services, open 8:30 AM to 9:30 PM. Walk in, or message 86001 29124 to book a slot and skip the wait.

props.label: About Us
props.heading: One salon, both sides of the chair
props.body:
Bloom & Blade is a unisex salon. That is not a detail on the signboard — it changes what we keep in the cabinet and who is behind the chair.

On the grooming side: haircuts, beard shaping, hair colour, ironing, tong and crimping. On the treatment side: facials, clean-up, D-tan, waxing, hair spa and bridal makeup. And the chemical work that needs real training — keratin, hair botox, nanoplastia and smoothing.

We use professional lines rather than whatever is cheapest, and we sell the same brands over the counter so the result you leave with can be maintained at home. Ask before you buy — the wrong shampoo will strip a keratin treatment in a fortnight.

Open from 8:30 in the morning to 9:30 at night, so a haircut before work or a treatment after it are both possible.

items.name: Harshal Pimpalkar
items.meta: Bloom & Blade Unisex Salon, Beltarodi Road
items.bio: Runs Bloom & Blade day to day and is usually in the salon. If you want to talk through a treatment before booking — whether keratin or nanoplastia suits your hair, what a bridal slot involves, or what something will cost — message 86001 29124 and you are talking to him directly.

items.name: Style that speaks. Confidence that stays.
items.bio: We would rather tell you a treatment is wrong for your hair than take the booking and have you back in a month unhappy. Chemical services get a condition check first, and every one leaves with aftercare instructions.

props.label: Services
props.heading: What we do
props.sub: Sixteen services for men and women. Rates depend on hair length, condition and the products used — message us and we will tell you exactly.

items.title: Haircut
items.desc: Cuts for men and women — a trim to keep a shape, or a full restyle. Tell us how you usually wear it and how much time you want to spend on it at home.

items.title: Beard
items.desc: Beard shaping, trims, line-ups and clean shaves. Fresh blade every customer, opened in front of you.

items.title: Make Up
items.desc: Party and occasion makeup, and full bridal. Bridal is by appointment — book well ahead in wedding season.

items.title: Keratin
items.desc: Keratin treatment for frizz control and manageability. Comes with aftercare instructions — the shampoo you use afterwards decides how long it lasts.

items.title: Hair Botox
items.desc: A deep conditioning treatment for damaged and over-processed hair. Different from keratin — we will tell you honestly which one your hair actually needs.

items.title: Nanoplastia
items.desc: Formaldehyde-free smoothing that keeps more movement than a traditional straightening. Suits anyone who wants smooth hair without it going flat.

items.title: Hair Smoothing
items.desc: Chemical smoothing for coarse or unmanageable hair. We check the condition of your hair first — smoothing damaged hair makes it worse, not better.

items.title: Hair Colour
items.desc: Global colour, root touch-ups and grey coverage using professional colour and matched developer.

items.title: Hair Highlights
items.desc: Highlights, balayage and streaks. Lightening is the hardest thing to undo, so we talk it through and check your hair can take it.

items.title: Facial
items.desc: Facials for different skin concerns — dullness, dryness, oiliness and tan. Tell us your skin type and what you have reacted to before.

items.title: Clean Up
items.desc: A shorter version of a facial — cleanse, scrub, steam, extraction and pack. Good every few weeks between full facials.

items.title: D-Tan
items.desc: De-tan treatment for face, neck, arms and back. Worth doing before a function rather than the morning of it.

items.title: Waxing
items.desc: Full and half waxing in a choice of waxes. Tell us if you have sensitive skin and we will use a gentler option.

items.title: Hair Spa
items.desc: A conditioning spa with massage — for dryness, scalp build-up, or simply because your hair has had a hard month.

items.title: Hair Ironing
items.desc: Straightening with an iron for the day — no chemicals, nothing permanent. The usual choice before a function.

items.title: Tong & Crimping
items.desc: Curls, waves and crimping for occasions. Best booked close to the event — it is a styling job, not a treatment.

props.termsBody:
Service rates depend on hair length, hair and skin condition, and the products used. The rate is confirmed before the service begins.

Chemical services — keratin, hair botox, nanoplastia, smoothing, colour and highlights — depend on the current condition of your hair. We may advise against a service, or recommend a different one, after seeing your hair in person. Results and how long they last vary between people.

Please tell us before any facial, waxing or colour service about allergies, skin sensitivity, recent treatments elsewhere, or medication that affects skin or hair. A patch test is advisable before a first colour service.

Appointments for bridal makeup and long chemical services may require an advance. Please give reasonable notice if you need to cancel or reschedule so the slot can be offered to someone else.

Retail products are sold sealed. For hygiene reasons opened products cannot be returned or exchanged unless faulty.

items.q: Why are rates not listed on the website?
items.a: Because most of our services genuinely cannot be priced from a list. A keratin treatment on short hair and on waist-length hair are different amounts of product and time, and a colour on virgin hair is not the same job as a colour over an old one. Message 86001 29124 with your hair length and what you want done and we will give you a proper figure.

items.q: Keratin, botox, nanoplastia or smoothing — which one do I need?
items.a: They solve different problems. Keratin is mainly for frizz and manageability, hair botox is a deep conditioning treatment for damaged hair, nanoplastia is a formaldehyde-free smoothing that keeps movement, and smoothing is the strongest and straightest result. The right answer depends on the condition of your hair, so let us see it first — we would rather talk you out of the wrong one than take the booking.

items.q: How long will a treatment last?
items.a: It varies with your hair and, more than anything, with what you wash it with afterwards. A sulphate shampoo will strip a keratin treatment quickly. We give aftercare instructions with every chemical service and stock the shampoos that protect the result.
Walk in for a haircut, beard or clean-up. Book ahead for keratin, smoothing, nanoplastia, highlights and any bridal or party makeup — these need a longer slot and, in wedding season, they fill up.
Yes. We serve both men and women, and we carry the products and the skills for both — grooming and beard work as well as colour, treatments and bridal makeup.
8:30 AM to 9:30 PM. The early and late slots are the quietest if you want to be in and out.

items.title: QOD De Fabulous — Shampoo & Conditioner
items.desc: Everyday cleansing and conditioning from the QOD professional range. Safe to use after chemical treatments.
items.body:
QOD De Fabulous shampoo and conditioner, from the QOD professional range.

This is an everyday pairing — the one to use if you want a professional shampoo without a specific problem to solve. It is safe over keratin, botox, nanoplastia and smoothing, which the supermarket shampoos generally are not.

A note worth reading if you have just had a treatment with us: sulphate shampoos strip keratin quickly, and most customers who complain a treatment 'did not last' were washing it with the wrong thing. Whatever you buy, check with us that it suits the service you have had.

Order here and we will confirm the current rate and availability before anything is dispatched, or collect from the salon.

items.title: QOD Argan — Shampoo & Conditioner
items.desc: Argan oil shampoo and conditioner for dry, frizzy or rough hair that needs more nourishment than a daily wash gives it.
items.body:
QOD Argan shampoo and conditioner — the argan oil line from QOD's professional range.

This is the one to reach for if your hair is dry, frizzy or rough to the touch, particularly through summer or after a lot of heat styling. Argan adds back some of what heat and sun take out.

If you have coloured or chemically treated hair and are not sure whether to take this or the De Fabulous line, ask us — the right answer depends on what was last done to your hair, not on which bottle looks nicer.

Order here and we will confirm the rate and availability before dispatch, or collect from the salon.

items.title: QOD Max Prime — Shampoo & Mask
items.desc: The intensive pairing — shampoo with a deep treatment mask, for hair that has been through colour, bleach or repeated straightening.
items.body:
QOD Max Prime shampoo and treatment mask.

This is the intensive option in the QOD range — the shampoo cleanses gently and the mask does the repairing work. It suits hair that has been through a lot: repeated colour, bleach or highlights, regular straightening, or a chemical service that did not go well elsewhere.

A mask is not a conditioner and is not meant for daily use. Once or twice a week is usually right; more than that and fine hair goes limp. Ask us how often to use it for your hair rather than guessing.

Order here and we will confirm the rate and availability before dispatch, or collect from the salon.

items.title: Wella Retail Products
items.desc: Wella professional retail range — shampoos, conditioners, masks and styling products. Tell us your hair type and what you want it to do.
items.body:
The Wella professional retail range — shampoos, conditioners, masks and styling products.

Wella covers most hair concerns across its lines: colour protection, repair for damaged hair, volume for fine hair and smoothing for coarse hair. Which line is right depends on your hair and on what was last done to it, which is why this listing asks what you are looking for rather than pretending one product suits everybody.

If you are unsure, pick 'Not sure' and tell us your hair type and the problem you want solved. We will suggest the right product rather than the dearest one.

Order here and we will confirm the rate and availability before dispatch, or collect from the salon.
